decisions.question: D14-Q01
decisions.selected: Linux x86_64; wallet also from source
decisions.rule: The release builds every node binary and operator tool for Linux x86_64, reproducibly. The CLI wallet ships as a Linux x86_64 binary too; on macOS and other systems it is installed from the release's source tag with `cargo install --locked`.

decisions.question: D14-Q01
decisions.rule: The release publishes its pinned build container so anyone can reproduce it. There is no node container: nodes run natively under the supervisor (AppArmor, seccomp, owner guard), with no second deployment path.

decisions.question: D14-Q01, D14-Q03
decisions.rule: Before the first release is tagged, mainnet/ moves with its history into the public DytallixHQ/dytallix repository, and releases are published there as GitHub Releases, tagged once in their final home. The founder creates the repository and enables two-factor authentication; the move itself is prepared as commands and CI.

decisions.question: D14-Q01, D11-Q03
decisions.rule: No separate release-signing key. The first release's manifest SHA-512 is in the genesis the 3-of-5 genesis keys sign, and every later release is approved on-chain by the 3-of-5 upgrade keys. GitHub tags, checksums and any GitHub signature (classical cryptography) are conveniences, never the release's authority.
